title: Statute of limitations.
bodyText: An action to enforce an obligation, duty, or right arising under this article must be commenced within three years after the cause of action accrues.
bodyHtml: §490:4-111  Statute of limitations.  An action to enforce an obligation, duty, or right arising under this article must be commenced within three years after the cause of action accrues. [L 1991, c 118, pt of §4]
